[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested making homemade kimchi if store-bought is not available.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for homemade kimchi, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant created a recipe for homemade kimchi with the following key details:  
- Ingredients: 2 lbs napa cabbage, 2 tablespoons coarse salt, 1/4 cup Korean chili flakes, 2 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup fish sauce, 1/4 cup Korean chili paste, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, 1/4 cup water, 1/4 cup chopped green onions, 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds (optional).  
- Instructions: Salting the cabbage, rinsing and draining, making the kimchi paste, assembling the kimchi, fermenting the kimchi, storing the kimchi.
